decisions.reason: High visible commitment as a new product line and central digital patient tool make management reluctant to drop it, viewing setbacks as temporary.
The continuing education institute involves sunk investment but lower visibility and peripheral fit, so there is a moderate chance of drop but escalation favors keeping for now.
As a peripheral support tool with limited visibility and investment, escalation pressures are weak, making it likely to be dropped to free resources.
The analytics dashboard is central to the firm's digital direction and was given its own page, so management is likely to keep it despite disappointing adoption.
The complete bundle is a high-investment, high-visibility core offering, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
The listing portal is peripheral with low visibility and limited centrality, so there is little escalation pressure and the firm is likely to drop it.
